name: Pocket Agent
desc: ⌘⇧Space: pops up over any app, reads that screen on-device, answers are copied for ⌘V.

name: pa-open
desc: Lets Pocket Agent open Settings pages (General, Wi-Fi, Bluetooth…).

name: Ask Pocket Agent
desc: Type or say a request — opens Pocket Agent and runs it. Add it to Siri, Back Tap or the Action button.

name: pa-control
desc: Lets Pocket Agent control brightness, volume, music, timers, reminders, calendar, speech, battery.
